values.meaning: cooldown reduction on Ki Barrier when an ability affects another champion

mechanics.claim: The shield is only granted after the triggering ability's effects have completed (e.g. when the Spirit Blade returns, the dash ends, or the channel finishes), not on cast.
mechanics.quote: After completing an {{tip|champion ability|ability's}} effects, '''Shen''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}}

mechanics.claim: The cooldown reduction only triggers if the ability affects at least one other champion (not just the shield itself).
mechanics.quote: If '''Shen''' affects at least one other {{tip|champion}} with an ability, ''Ki Barrier's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced

mechanics.claim: The passive cooldown starts upon gaining the shield, not upon the triggering ability's cast.
